Product files: forms/export.ts, shared forms-records.ts, openapi.yaml (the FormRecordExport schema and the CSV response description) and web app.css.

Contract:
- zod has illustrativeLabel: z.string().min(1).nullable(), required. OpenAPI has the same field in required, type [string, null], minLength 1, and additionalProperties false is kept. The two agree.
- The server always sends the field (export.ts:271-275), so making it required in the response schema is correct. Nothing is removed or retyped.
- The one in-repo consumer is the web export dialog: api.get<FormRecordExport> with no strict parse, and a raw JSON download. It is unaffected, and typecheck passes.
- The contract test validates the field.

Detection:
- export.ts:235 calls @mth/db readDeploymentEnvironment. It returns synthetic only when the singleton marker says demo; no marker means production. This is the same source as GET /environment and the report snapshots.
- 0090:35 gives mth_app SELECT only, and the table is append-only.
- The value is one of two constants, held equal to the reporting pipeline's export.illustrative strings by the regression test.

CSV:
- The label row goes through the same csvCell. Both strings start with a letter, so it is never prefixed or quoted.
- The BOM stays first. A non-demo CSV is byte-identical to before.
- The one-field first row is the D-178 design and matches the report pipeline's CSV (reporting/src/csv.ts:64). Observation: a strict CSV reader would take that row as the header of a demo export. It is demo-only, with no security effect.

Authorization: unchanged (transformation.read in scope, otherwise 404). The marker read is a read on the pool, with no transaction and no remote I/O.

CSS: overflow-wrap and min-inline-size rules only. No url(), @import or content.

Pre-existing observation, not new in wave AA and not required by ADR-0041 §5: buildFormExport reads rows and custom values in separate statements, not in one snapshot.

The probes in SEC-R6-08 and SEC-R6-09 confirm all of this by execution. Details are in 10-source-review-notes.md.

Demo detection reads the immutable, append-only deployment marker, fails safe to production, and cannot be changed by mth_app (42501 on INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE, probed). My seven probe files pass 41/41: the AUD and ADM-only sweep, Studio separation of duties, 0096, the demo guards and the export label. The validators pass (historical DG4-DG1, register DG5). The p5-pending lists are empty.

- the one-field label row in a demo CSV (D-178 design, the same as the report CSV);
- the form export's multi-statement read (pre-existing);
- the reserved, unused migration numbers (planned in p5-work-split and D-145).
